The plan is below. --- ## Implementation plan: resume a final merge that ran out of attempts once its blocker clears **Planning ref:** `main` @ `a638db873808068331eba28b4f629c7ca9bfea68`. Integration branch mismatch: `unknown`, which is not `true`, so planning goes ahead. **Clarification answers:** the only answer is `/answer [auto-answered-by-poller]`, posted by stall recovery. It adds no answers. The issue body is detailed enough to plan from, so no assumption fills a gap the issue leaves open. ### §20.E automation summary - **Script change:** extends existing code only. No new script, workflow or supervisor, so nothing goes in `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`. - **Entry point:** the existing scheduled poller. `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` runs `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` on its schedule and on manual dispatch. The new switch is added to the env blocks the poller already reads (§8 default `true`). - **Supervisor:** none needed. The check runs inside the existing per-project loop on every tick. - **DB work:** none. The "once per head SHA" limit is stored in the project's state, as a list of head SHAs. ## Files likely to change - `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` - `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` - `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py` - `README.md` - `changelog.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md` (new) - `agents.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md` (new) ## Acceptance ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py::test_final_merge_auto_resume_retries_green_mergeable_pr red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py::test_final_merge_exhaustion_records_failure_kind_and_head_sha red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py::test_final_merge_auto_resume_once_per_head_sha red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py::test_final_merge_auto_resume_skip_reasons red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py::test_final_merge_auto_resume_disabled_keeps_project_parked red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py::test_final_merge_auto_resume_ignores_other_failed_projects ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py ACCEPTANCE: post-merge none: the path only runs on scheduled poller ticks for projects parked by final-merge exhaustion; the contract tests above cover it and no deploy workflow is involved ## Functions or modules to implement The model to follow is the engine-aware security-pass auto-reset in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`: - the switch is normalised around lines 2738–2755; - the per-project block is around lines 28965–29036 and uses the `security_pass_auto_reset_engine_shas` list; - its tests are `_run_failed_project_tick` and the `test_security_pass_*auto_reset*` tests in `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` (around lines 5418–5690). **1. Switch (top of the script, next to the `SECURITY_PASS_AUTO_RESET_ON_ENGINE_CHANGE` block).** - `if is_truthy "${FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED:-true}"; then FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED="true"; else ...="false"; fi` - Add a comment that cites shubhodeep1/fun-token-multi-chain#579 / #596 as the incident. - Name check: `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME` appears nowhere in the repo today, so both the switch and the log prefix are free. **2. Record why the project failed, in the exhaustion path of `mark_validation_complete` (around lines 17380–17407).** - Before the existing `.status = "failed" | .final_merge_status = "failed"` write, find the final PR's head SHA: - first from `_security_final_pr_json` (`.head.sha`) when it is set; - otherwise with one `_fetch_pr_json "${_final_pr}"` call, only when `_final_pr` is a number. - This runs once per exhaustion, not every tick. Add a §14 comment saying which existing call was reused. - Keep the value only if it matches `^[0-9a-f]{40}$`; otherwise store `""`. - Add both fields to the same jq write, so the change stays atomic: `| .final_merge_failure_kind = "final_merge_exhausted" | .final_merge_failure_head_sha = $sha` - In the success write in the same function (status `complete`), add `| .final_merge_failure_kind = null`. Keep `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas`. **3. New helper `maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion` (defined near `maybe_apply_force_merge_bypass`).** It returns 0 only when the project resumed. Every skip prints exactly one line: `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME tracking_issue= outcome=skip reason=[ detail=]` Checks run in this order, so the cheapest ones stop most projects first. The first five make no API call. 1. Switch is not `true` → `disabled`. 2. State is unreadable, or `.final_merge_failure_kind != "final_merge_exhausted"` → `not_final_merge_exhausted`. 3. `.validation_last_passed_sha` is not 40 lowercase hex characters → `validation_not_recorded`. This reason is new; see D3. 4. `.final_merge_pr` is not a number → `lookup_failed detail=no_final_pr`. 5. `_fetch_pr_json` result is not an object with numeric `.number` and string `.state` → `lookup_failed detail=pr_read`. 6. PR is not `.state == "open"`, is merged, or is a draft → `pr_not_open` (`detail=closed|merged|draft`). 7. `.head.sha` is not 40 hex → `lookup_failed detail=head_sha`. 8. Head SHA is already in `.final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas` → `already_resumed_on_head`. 9. Head SHA differs from `validation_last_passed_sha` → `validation_not_recorded detail=head_moved`. 10. `.mergeable != true` or `.mergeable_state != "clean"` → `not_mergeable`. This includes `null`, which means GitHub is still computing; that case gets `detail=unknown`. 11. `_pr_checks_completed "${pr}" "${head}" "${base_ref}"`, called with three arguments so only required checks count (the helper resolves them through `_pr_required_check_names_for_base`): - return 0 (`ok`/`allow_all`) passes; - `PR_CHECKS_LAST_REASON` of `query_failed` or `unresolved_head_sha` → `lookup_failed detail=checks`; - anything else → `checks_not_green`. 12. `compute_cycle_integration_ahead_by`: - empty or non-numeric `CWS_AHEAD_BY` → `lookup_failed detail=compare`; - `0` → `not_ahead`. When every check passes, resume in this order: - **a.** `set_tracking_phase_label "ai:validated"`. `ai:blocked`, `ai:needs-human` and `ai:validated` are all in the `issue_phase` group of `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json`, so this one call swaps the labels. If it fails, skip with `lookup_failed detail=label_write` and leave state unchanged. - **b.** One atomic jq write: - `.status = "validating"` - `.final_merge_status = "pending"` - `.final_merge_attempt_count = 0` - `.final_merge_failure_kind = null` - `.final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas = ((((.final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas // []) | map(select(. != $h))) + [$h]) | .[-20:])` - Keep `final_merge_pr` and `final_merge_error`. - If the write fails: remove the temp file, try to put `ai:blocked` back, log `skip reason=lookup_failed detail=state_write`, and return 1. - **c.** Update `TRACKING_LABELS` in memory without another API call: `map(select(. != "ai:blocked" and . != "ai:needs-human")) + ["ai:validated"] | unique`. - **d.** Log `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME tracking_issue= outcome=resumed final_pr=

head_sha=`, then `post_state_comment || true`. - **e.** Post one tracking comment, starting with the marker ``, headed "## 🔁 Final integration merge retried automatically". It names the PR, the head SHA, the one-retry-per-head rule and the `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED=false` switch. - **f.** Send `tg_notify ... "DEBUG"`. **4. Hook in the terminal-state block (around lines 29521–29533).** - Place it inside the `failed`/`validation-failed` branch, after the `ai:force-merge` bypass block and before `echo "Project already ${PROJECT_STATUS}, skipping."`. - Run it only when `PROJECT_STATUS = "failed"`. - If `maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion` returns 0: - set `PROJECT_STATUS="validating"`; - set `VALIDATION_CYCLE` from `.validation_cycle // 1`, checked to be numeric and at least 1, as in the validating branch; - set `LAST_VAL_RAW_STATUS=''` and `LAST_VAL_CONCLUSION=''`; - call `mark_validation_complete "${VALIDATION_CYCLE}"`, then `continue`. - This retries through the existing path, so the security pass, validation-history gate, readiness gate, required-checks gate, head-bound merge and comprehensive promotion all still apply. - If the retry fails with a failure that counts against the budget, the project stays `validating`. The next ticks retry through the normal validating path, up to `MAX_FINAL_MERGE_ATTEMPTS`, and then park again with the marker. The tick after that logs `already_resumed_on_head`. - `needs_human_digest_prune` already drops the digest entry later in the same tick, because the label is gone. ## Data structures affected Tracking-state JSON gets three new optional fields; none existed before: - `final_merge_failure_kind`: `"final_merge_exhausted"` or `null`. - `final_merge_failure_head_sha`: 40-hex string or `""`. - `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas`: array of 40-hex strings, last 20 kept. Existing fields this path writes: - `status` - `final_merge_status` - `final_merge_attempt_count` Older state without the new fields reads as "not exhausted", so it is left alone (see D2). ## API or interface changes - **New variable:** `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED`, default `true`. Added to both poller env blocks in `orchestrate_poll.yml`, around lines 1388 and 1612, as `${{ vars.FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED || 'true' }}`. - **New stable log prefix:** `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME`, with `outcome=resumed|skip`. - Skip reasons from the issue: `disabled`, `not_final_merge_exhausted`, `pr_not_open`, `not_mergeable`, `checks_not_green`, `already_resume
